prefix.description: SEL-3560S — compact RTAC variant of the SEL-3560 Real-Time Automation Controller (no internal power supply, no PCI/PCIe expansion slots; base 2 EIA-232 DB-9 serial ports with an optional SEL-3390S8 serial card adding up to 12 EIA-232/EIA-422/EIA-485 ports). Rated -40 C to +75 C with the E3-1505L CPU. The expandable sibling is the SEL-3560E (SEL-9331 power supply, expansion slots).

part_number.note: No configurable per-digit Model Option Table is emitted. The SEL-3560 RTAC is ordered as a base catalog unit (SEL-3560S compact vs SEL-3560E expandable) with configuration options — CPU, RAM (8/16/32/64 GB ECC, factory-installed), SATA storage, operating system, thermal option (standard vs conduction-cooled heatsink), and the SEL-3390S8 serial expansion card — selected via SEL's interactive Model Option Table, not encoded as a fixed-length decodable part-number string. No ordering-information document exists in the local SEL index for this model (only the data sheet and instruction manual); the instruction manual states outright that it 'does not provide complete ordering information'; no genuine SEL-3560S part number was found in uploads/test; and the data sheet contains no part-number template or ordering appendix. The drawing layers present in this metadata (Standard vs Conduction-Cooled heatsink) describe the physical thermal build of the unit but are NOT used here as part-number position anchors. positions:[] is intentional; the decoder returns no attributes.
references: SEL-3560 RTAC Data Sheet (3560_DS_20241218.pdf) — no Model Option Table / part-number template present
SEL-3560 RTAC Instruction Manual (3560_IM_20241218_20260313.pdf) — explicitly states it does not provide complete ordering information; no PARTNO appendix
